items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Because I’m from the old jazz, you know, like Bunny Berigan, guys like this.

ctx.x: Very quickly, what’s your take on the state of jazz today?

Jazz is alive I love it. There’s nothing wrong with jazz, it’s just we’re not getting enough exposure to the people. Because not enough radio stations play it, and like you get KCR and BGO, they’re playing some far out jazz that a lot of people don’t really like to listen to. So that’s my personal feeling. Because sometimes I listen to those stations and I don’t really like what I hear. Because I’m from the old jazz, you know, like Bunny Berigan, guys like this. And I love jazz, but when I listen to some of those…
